sources.snippet: Overview Droplychee-2.0-40B is a multilingual decoder-only foundation language model developed by Droplychee AI Research. The project is built upon the Qwen model family and further adapted through full supervised fine-tuning together with long-context optimization using YaRN (Yet another RoPE extensioN).
